description.from:
Outcome: One suite that tries every way tenant A could see or change tenant B's data, run against a sandbox or staging shared stack with two seeded tenants. Generated from schema.ts and the function list, so a new model, index, query, mutation or function without a case fails CI. Cases: every model x {get, list, list by each index, create with foreign tenantId, update to foreign tenantId, delete}; every custom query and mutation with foreign ids; subscriptions; S3 (presign foreign key, direct identity-pool access, rendition paths); knowledge search (knowledge-query, the S3 Vectors index, the title-word table); snapshot and projection outputs (no foreign rows in tenant files); the edge (Host header spoofing, unknown host, path traversal into another prefix); the reader API (forged Origin, foreign subject ids); exports (an export of A contains nothing of B); CLI with a token for A and --tenant B.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new features_backend/tenant-isolation-adversarial.feature and its steps (features_backend/steps/), a generator script under scripts/ reading amplify/data/schema.ts and amplify/functions/*/resource.ts, seed fixtures for two tenants.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-isolation-adversarial.feature):
Scenario Outline: Tenant A cannot reach tenant B through any model operation
    Given editor sessions for "alpha" and "beta" on the shared stack
    When the "alpha" session performs <operation> on a "beta" <model>
    Then it is denied or returns nothing of "beta"
    Examples: generated from the schema

Scenario: A model with no isolation case fails the build
    Given a new model is added to schema.ts without a generated case
    When CI runs
    Then the suite fails naming the model

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-9f3de0. Blocks PPY-bdc4ee, PPY-f7ce77, PPY-3ff465. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-5e0259.

Testing: It is the test. Runs in report-only mode from PPY-06ae68, blocking from PPY-bdc4ee.
Rollout: Lives in CI; the gate itself is PPY-f7ce77.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: the suite gives false confidence because it only checks what it knows. Mitigation: generation from the schema and the function list, plus the external security review (PPY-3ff465).

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
